description: Capture the current screen as an unchanged JPEG image with its width and height. Establishes this session's pixel coordinates for later absolute mouse actions. If pointer movement disagrees with the image, an extended desktop may need a shared KVM mapping. Stop positioned clicks/drags and consult setup and get_mouse_mapping.
name: capture_screen

description: Type command plus Enter in one raw keyboard action, wait for output, then capture a fresh frame and extract text with local Tesseract OCR, optionally limited to a region in screenshot pixels. Language defaults to eng; combinations such as eng+swe require matching traineddata on the MCP host. The wait is cancellable, defaults to 1 second and accepts 0 through 60 seconds; a fresh frame does not prove the command has completed. Does not establish screenshot coordinates. Consult setup before entering target commands.

command.description: Command to type literally and execute with Enter.

language.description: Tesseract language model names, for example eng or eng+swe. Default eng. All requested traineddata files must be installed on the MCP host.

region.description: Optional OCR region in original screenshot pixels. Must fit entirely inside the captured image; omission analyzes the full screenshot.

height.description: Positive region height in screenshot pixels.

width.description: Positive region width in screenshot pixels.

x.description: Left edge in original screenshot pixels, measured from the top-left corner.

y.description: Top edge in original screenshot pixels, measured from the top-left corner.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before a fresh capture. Finite 0 through 60, default 1. A fixed wait does not guarantee command completion.

name: execute_and_read

description: Read configured serial and target screen settings, active keyboard layout, and capture information from the daemon.
name: get_device_info

description: Read the shared KVM mouse mapping, mode, revision, configured geometry and readiness. An unset display offset differs from a configured zero. Consult setup before target work. If movement disagrees with the image, check coordinate units and the target's actual absolute HID input span before changing this shared mapping.
name: get_mouse_mapping

description: Capture the current target screen and extract text with local Tesseract OCR, optionally limited to a region in screenshot pixels. Language defaults to eng; combinations such as eng+swe require matching traineddata on the MCP host. Prefer this to an image for terminal text. Does not establish screenshot coordinates for mouse actions.

language.description: Tesseract language model names, for example eng or eng+swe. Default eng. All requested traineddata files must be installed on the MCP host.

region.description: Optional OCR region in original screenshot pixels. Must fit entirely inside the captured image; omission analyzes the full screenshot.

height.description: Positive region height in screenshot pixels.

width.description: Positive region width in screenshot pixels.

x.description: Left edge in original screenshot pixels, measured from the top-left corner.

y.description: Top edge in original screenshot pixels, measured from the top-left corner.

name: get_screen_text

description: List capture devices available to the daemon.
name: list_capture_devices

description: List the daemon's built-in and configured custom text layouts and current selection. Entries report their source and any load error; this does not change the layout or target OS input source.
name: list_keyboard_layouts

description: Click left, right or middle (default left). Optional x and y are pixels in this session's latest successful capture_screen; supply both. A click at the current pointer needs no screenshot. Optional button_mode overrides the daemon setting. If pointer movement disagrees with the image, an extended desktop may need a shared KVM mapping. Stop positioned clicks/drags and consult setup and get_mouse_mapping.

button.description: left, right, or middle. Default left.

button_mode.description: absolute or relative. Omit to use the daemon's configured mode.

x.description: Optional screenshot x pixel. Supply both x and y.

y.description: Optional screenshot y pixel. Supply both x and y.

name: mouse_click

description: Drag in one atomic daemon action, with 50 ms after button down and after the move. Both endpoints are pixels in this session's latest successful capture_screen image. Default button left; button_mode may override the daemon setting. If pointer movement disagrees with the image, an extended desktop may need a shared KVM mapping. Stop positioned clicks/drags and consult setup and get_mouse_mapping.

button.description: left, right, or middle. Default left.

button_mode.description: absolute or relative. Omit to use the daemon's configured mode.

end_x.description: End x pixel in the latest screenshot.

end_y.description: End y pixel in the latest screenshot.

start_x.description: Start x pixel in the latest screenshot.

start_y.description: Start y pixel in the latest screenshot.

name: mouse_drag

description: Move the target pointer. Absolute x/y are integer pixels in this session's latest successful capture_screen image; capture first. Relative deltas are unchanged and each must be -127 through 127. If pointer movement disagrees with the image, an extended desktop may need a shared KVM mapping. Stop positioned clicks/drags and consult setup and get_mouse_mapping.

relative.description: Use unscaled relative deltas, each -127 through 127. Default false.

x.description: Screenshot x pixel, or signed horizontal delta when relative is true.

y.description: Screenshot y pixel, or signed vertical delta when relative is true.

name: mouse_move

description: Scroll the target's wheel by a signed amount, clamped to -127 through 127.

amount.description: Signed wheel amount, clamped by the daemon to -127 through 127.

name: mouse_scroll

description: Clear configured geometry, retaining the current mode. Extended becomes not ready; explicitly set mode=legacy to restore identity. Releases held mouse input and invalidates this session's screenshot coordinates.
name: reset_mouse_mapping

description: Press and release one named key or 0x-prefixed HID keycode, with optional ctrl, shift, alt or super modifiers.

key.description: Named key such as enter, escape, f1, a, or a 0x-prefixed HID keycode.

modifiers.description: Modifiers such as ctrl, shift, alt, or super.

name: send_key

description: Send one atomic keyboard sequence of at most 4096 steps. The complete sequence is validated first. Step delays default to 100 ms and may be 0 through 60000 ms.

default_delay_ms.description: Default delay after each key in milliseconds, 0 through 60000. Default 100.

steps.description: Complete sequence, at most 4096 steps. Every step is validated before typing.

delay_ms.description: Delay after this key in milliseconds, 0 through 60000.

modifiers.description: Modifiers such as ctrl, shift, alt, or super.

name: send_key_sequence

description: Select a capture device by path. Every attempt invalidates this session's screenshot coordinates, including failed attempts; capture_screen again before absolute mouse input.

device.description: Capture device path such as /dev/video0, macOS avfoundation:NAME, or Windows dshow:SELECTOR from list_capture_devices. Numeric indexes are not supported.

name: set_capture_device

description: Set a positive capture width and height. Every attempt invalidates this session's screenshot coordinates, including failed attempts; capture_screen again before absolute mouse input.
name: set_capture_resolution

description: Select the daemon's target text layout for subsequent keyboard actions without restarting or reconnecting. Use list_keyboard_layouts to discover names. This runtime setting does not change the target OS input source or screenshot coordinates; restart restores the configured startup layout. Selecting the same name reloads its file. Use sequential requests through one MCP connection.

layout.description: Target text layout name: us104, uk105, de105, fr105, jp106, se105, or a custom name from the daemon's configured layouts directory.

name: set_keyboard_layout

description: Select legacy/extended mode or apply complete display-offset/desktop-span geometry after structural bounds validation. The mapping lives in the KVM and subsequent mouse actions inherit it, with no per-call offset arguments. Geometry values must use the same desktop units. This invalidates this session's screenshot coordinates. Consult setup before target work. If movement disagrees with the image, check coordinate units and the target's actual absolute HID input span before changing this shared mapping.

geometry.description: Optional complete desktop geometry in the same desktop units, including signed display offset and the span addressed by absolute HID. Applies immediately after structural bounds validation; the caller must supply correct target geometry. An offset alone is insufficient.

mode.description: legacy restores the identity mapping; extended blocks positioned input until geometry is configured. Reset preserves this mode.

name: set_mouse_mapping

description: Start here: read the target-control setup checklist once before work and after target/display/layout changes. Returns guidance only; performs no device queries or input.
name: setup

description: Type text on the target keyboard. The entire text is validated against the active target layout before input. By default {enter} and {ctrl+c} are key tags; raw types braces literally. Character delay defaults to 20 ms.

char_delay_ms.description: Delay after each character or tag, including the last, in milliseconds, 0 through 60000. Default 20.

raw.description: Type braces literally instead of interpreting key tags. Default false.

text.description: Text to type. Characters unavailable in the target layout are rejected before typing.

name: type_text
